scientific_integrity: Every claimed all-length statement is supported by the mathematical proof. The cited general extremal bound is credited as established prior work; no independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two opposing binary single-transition input words with four positive run lengths and counts distinct shortest supersequence outputs, not alignment multiplicities or arbitrary longer minimal common supersequences. Known general upper bound and central-binomial asymptotic are not claimed as new. A complete historical priority check, including the older Fraser–Irving–Middendorf article, remains outstanding. Finite computational checks corroborate but do not replace the symbolic proof.
title: Exact shortest-common-supersequence counts and all extremizers for opposing two-run binary inputs
